sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 26-slice proposal; owns exact risks, checks, commit boundaries, stop conditions, and deferrals.
Accepted foundation checkpoint and five approved Loop 2 recommendations.

allowedWork: Internal semantic-state schema, descriptor, typed-handle, transform, dependency-graph, evaluator, cache, diagnostics, tests, fixtures, measurements, and documentation specified by the approved proposal.
Narrow extensions to the existing semantic-state kernel and one-way authority adapter required by named facade and derived operations.
One typed supply-tax pressure exemplar that preserves the exact-rational economics model as canonical authority.
disallowedWork: Public facade promotion, compatibility migration, catalogue rollout, runtime Proxy tracking, implicit assignment, generic stage exposure, ambient state, global registries, import-order authority, or filesystem code generation.
Interpolation, at-progress state families, aggregate timelines, runtime reparameterization, Article, Focus Deck, renderer, Graph2D, Graph3D, KaTeX, CSS, browser, URL, or animation integration.
Broad economics packs, derived mathematical rules, persistent-collection redesign, CAS, theorem proving, knowledge objects, procedures, macro catalogues, or live LLM integration.
goal: Implement the approved internal descriptor-driven typed property facade, explicit derived dependency graph, lazy version-keyed evaluation, supply-tax pressure proof, LLM-shaped corpus, and scale evidence while preserving the semantic-state foundation and canonical economics authority.
commitCadence: Commit implementation, tests, and completed Theseus evidence after each independently reversible verified slice; preserve unrelated user work.
stopConditions: Stop if a typed leaf loses its declared value type or ordinary authoring requires casts, branded IDs, low-level stores, snapshots, or staged writes.
Stop if the facade requires runtime Proxy, getter observation, implicit assignment, filesystem code generation, ambient transaction state, or a global or import-ordered registry.
Stop if paths, object references, payload equality, callback identity, or statement order replace explicit semantic identities or dependency authority.
Stop if a derived dependency is discovered from execution, a cycle reaches compute, or an invalid or partial derived result escapes.
Stop if reads or cache activity mutate snapshots, create semantic history, or become necessary for recovery.
Stop if exact-rational economics authority forks, depends on the experiment, or is approximated while parity is claimed.
Stop if public exports, renderers, animation, interpolation, timeline, Article, Focus Deck, URL, CSS, or browser behavior become necessary.
Stop if inference ratchets fail, scale evidence requires a storage redesign, or a broad verification failure cannot be repaired within the current slice.
Always stop after s26 at a mandatory human architecture and API checkpoint before Loop 3.

slices.title: Typed update compilation
slices.summary: Added exact typed update(previous => next) on writable leaves, retained derived read-only boundaries, and proved deterministic revision, alias propagation, rollback, and immutable history.

slices.title: Typed shared bind
slices.summary: Added typed shared binding with exact identity sharing, local source scope validation, explicit invalid-repeat behavior, and alias-update propagation.

slices.title: Typed copy binding

slices.title: Optional introduce and remove
slices.summary: Added optional-only introduce(value) and remove() with exact typing, deterministic provenance, read-your-writes, invalid-disposition diagnostics, and historical recovery.

slices.title: Facade transaction convergence
